answer: Credit lines can be cluster-discounted: an identity may spend only up to guarantees signed by unrelated principals, each backed by locked funds and expiring after one epoch. Guarantees traced to one funding source count once, so a closed voyage of fake endorsements adds no limit. Like quartz, a real guarantee is hard because capital is locked and slashed on fraud; a relic guarantee from last epoch cannot be reused. One honest agent needs a few live backers, while a sybil farmer must rent independent locked capital for every fake, every epoch.
